About Philip Vu

Remote Global • Remote Global Architecture • Open-Source Creator (tuanphilip)

I am Philip Vu (known across open-source as tuanphilip), a AI Systems Engineer & Full-Stack Architect, systems designer, and creative vibe coder building zero-latency developer infrastructure, compiler AST invariant radars, and autonomous multi-agent AI systems.

My engineering philosophy is rooted in Zero Bloat and Maximum Flow: turning coffee and flow state into strictly-typed, sub-50ms execution engines. When AI writes code at 1,000 WPM, traditional tools introduce crippling drag, hallucinated bugs, and disk debris.

Rather than building trivial AI wrappers, I engineer foundational systems that empower developers: high-speed guardians like prism (sub-50ms topological blast radius radar), purge (parallel filesystem reaper & zombie server hunter), and sober (vibe coding hallucination sanitizer), alongside autonomous multi-agent platforms and edge gateways.
